The Mission That Made History | Star Gazers 54Likes3,025ViewsJan 272026 Ahead of the Artemis II launch, here's what you need to know about our very 1st moon landing! On July 20, 1969, humanity achieved the unthinkable. Apollo 11, NASA’s landmark mission, saw astronauts Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin walk on the lunar surface, while Michael Collins orbited above in the Command Module. Star Gazers host Trace Dominguez explores this historic journey, from liftoff to splashdown, and reflects on how it changed our view of the universe forever.
